label: Seed-VC singing conversion
summary: Optional zero-shot singing conversion for replacing or coloring a preserved vocal while retaining the source and exact conversion settings.

handoffs.label: Convert a vocal candidate
handoffs.intent: Compare an original vocal with one locally converted candidate in a reversible song experiment.
inputs: An immutable source vocal and explicit target voice direction
Model, step count, backend, seed, and consent/rights record
outputs: A new lossless converted candidate and provenance sidecar
steps: Run in the isolated Seed-VC environment
Keep raw and converted audio side by side
Audition before any mix or release decision
verification: Check duration, sample rate, clipping, checksum, and audible artifacts
Confirm the source was not overwritten and the target identity is permitted

preserve: Source vocal, conversion settings, model identity, and rights evidence
avoid: Living-artist imitation by name, in-place conversion, and presenting a test candidate as approved
